;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[April 2017 Turkish airstrikes in Syria and Iraq]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] air strikes kill 18 [[Kurds|Kurdish]] [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] fighters and media officials in northeastern [[Syria]]. Also five [[Peshmerga]] fighters are killed during a [[Turkish Air Force|Turkish]] attack on [[Sinjar]] in [[Iraq]]. Turkey also claims to have destroyed "terror hubs". Iraq denounces the strike as a violation of its sovereignty. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-turkey-toll-idUSKBN17R0WE (Reuters)] [http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkey-hits-pkk-targets-in-iraq-syria-.aspx?pageID=238&nID=112396&NewsCatID=352 (''Hurriet Daily News'')]

;Arts and culture
*Wikipedia co-founder [[Jimmy Wales]] announces plans for a crowdfunded news website, ''[[Wikitribune]]'', that will publish stories by journalists, with contributions, including [[fact checking]], by volunteers to, among other goals, counter the recent spread of so-called "[[fake news]]". [http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/wikipedia-founder-jimmy-wales-launches-project-fix-news-n750591?cid=sm_npd_nn_fb_ma (NBC News)] [http://www.niemanlab.org/2017/04/wikipedia-founder-jimmy-wales-launches-wikitribune-news-by-the-people-and-for-the-people/ (Nieman Foundation for Journalism)]

;Business and economy
*United States Secretary of the Interior [[Ryan Zinke]] says that [[Donald Trump]] plans to review [[National Monument (United States)|U.S. national monument]]s. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/energy-environment/wp/2017/04/25/zinke-to-review-large-national-monuments-created-since-1996-to-make-sure-the-people-have-a-voice/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Twenty-seven people are killed in Kenya's [[Makueni County]] when a bus and a truck collide on the [[Nairobi–Mombasa Road]]. [https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001237570/27-people-die-in-fatal-accident-along-mombasa-nairobi-highway (''The Standard'')]

;International relations
*[[Saudi Arabia]] is among twelve countries newly elected to the [[United Nations Commission on the Status of Women]], despite the nation's [[Women's rights in Saudi Arabia|conflicts with women's rights]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-04-25/saudi-arabia-un-womens-council-gender-equality-concerns/8469258 (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**The [[USS Michigan (SSGN-727)|USS ''Michigan'']] docks at [[Busan]], South Korea, amid growing concerns over North Korean weapons development. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-39701481 (BBC)]
*[[Germany–Israel relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] cancels a visit with the [[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Germany)|foreign minister of Germany]] [[Sigmar Gabriel]] after the latter's refusal to cancel a meeting with the [[Israel Defense Forces]] [[veteran]]s [[non-governmental organization|NGO]] [[Breaking the Silence (non-governmental organization)|Breaking the Silence]] saying the group "slanders IDF soldiers as war criminals"[http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/national/israel-pm-cancels-talk-german-fm-rare-spat-ally-article-1.3097615 (''New York Daily News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[India]] is to provide every cow with a [[Biometrics|biometric]] [[pet tag|dog tag]], in an effort to prevent [[Cattle raiding|cattle smuggling]]. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/soon-aadhaar-like-id-for-cattle/articleshow/58352347.cms (''Times of India'')]
*The [[United States]] announced it will end a six-year [[Central African Republic|Central-African]] hunt for [[Joseph Kony]] the following day. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170426143322/http://pulse.ng/world/joseph-kony-us-troops-end-hunt-for-lra-warlord-after-6-years-id6579489.html (AFP via ''Pulse.ng'')]
*[[Gun politics in the United States]]
**An affiliate of the [[National Rifle Association|NRA]] sues [[California]] for alleged discrimination. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/04/25/nra-sues-california-over-gun-control-laws-that-demonize-firearm-owners.html (Fox News)]
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**U.S. District Court Judge [[William Orrick III|William Orrick]] rules that President [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Executive Order 13768|executive order]] withholding federal funds from [[sanctuary city|sanctuary cities]] is unconstitutional. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-fix/wp/2017/04/25/california-is-in-a-war-with-trump-on-sanctuary-cities-and-it-just-won-its-first-major-battle/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Sports
*In [[auto racing]], longtime [[NASCAR]] [[Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series|Cup Series]] star [[Dale Earnhardt Jr.]] announces that he will retire at the end of the [[2017 Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series|2017 season]]. [http://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/cup/story/_/id/19238738/dale-earnhardt-jr-retire-2017-season (ESPN)]
